result.instructions: Co-Legal legal/fiscal lookup tools for Belgium (Vlaams Gewest primary) and the Netherlands. All tools are read-only and hit official public sources, returning a concise answer with citation URLs. Use them to ground answers about Belgian company numbers (KBO/BCE), EU VAT validation (VIES), Belgian & Dutch case law (ECLI), EU legislation (EUR-Lex/CELEX), Belgian legislation (Justel) and Dutch legislation (wetten.overheid.nl). Informational only — not legal advice.
